description: Look up what previous sessions learned about this app — failures and the recovery that worked. Returns short summaries so it is cheap to call at the start of a session; pass full:true or an id to read one in detail. Search it whenever a step fails, before asking the user for help.

full.description: Return complete entries instead of summaries.

id.description: Return this single entry in full.

query.description: Words to match against category, failure, recovery, pattern or URL. Omit for the most recent.

name: memory_get
